cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.
